sequence: una = UNA(verbosity=1)  -- UNA.__init__ builds Topology() and Settings()+Reset()
settings attribute assembly (public attrs; O2.manifest settings_overrides + file paths + unique output_folder)

una.RunAccessibility()  -- internally: settings.Validation(); topology.AddNetwork -> AddOrigins -> AddDestinations; engine dispatch turns=False -> AccessibilityWElevation(topology, settings); .Centrality(settings); ExportAccessibilityResults(folder_prefix='accessibility_', file_name='Results')

una.RunFlow() on the SAME UNA object  -- internally: settings.Validation(); AddNetwork/AddOrigins/AddDestinations (layers RELOADED); BuildClusters(min(cpu_count-1,16), radius); auto cap: flow_decay & flow_decay_method=='gravity_cap' & cap is str -> _ResolveGravityCap() runs an internal AccessibilityWElevation Centrality pass and writes numeric cap back to settings; engine dispatch flow_engine=='aggregate_flow' -> AggregateFlow(topology); .Centrality(settings); ExportFlowResult(folder_prefix='flow_')
una.RunAccessibility() again with changed settings (search_radius 500->800, new output folder) -- sequential-reuse chronology
